class.name: VideoStreamMP4
class.description: [VideoStream] resource handling MP4 container files with [code].mp4[/code], [code].m4v[/code] and [code].mov[/code] extensions, decoded on the CPU through FFmpeg. Supported codecs depend on the FFmpeg build linked into the engine (typically H.264/H.265 video and AAC audio). [b]Note:[/b] The H.264 and H.265 codecs are patent-encumbered in some jurisdictions. This module links the system FFmpeg libraries and is only available in custom builds.
